observations.summary: The owner test does not pin the owner comparison: M3 (owner taken from the sample) survives because the test observes only with the real owner; one wrong-uid assertion (as probe O3) would pin it. Mode, foreign-ACE and inheritance refusals of the composed function are covered only by the predicate's synthetic tests and this probe.

A positive result speaks only for the directory object at capture time through the caller's descriptor: an explicitly empty returned ACL is accepted (O9, consistent with the predicate: a returned empty ACL is evidence; omission and the sentinel are not); contents are not judged (O11); path resolution, symlinks at open and parent/path admission are the caller's. The doc could also say 'the directory object only; not its contents'.

Full security suite environment: 80 custody-test failures need a custody-safe TMPDIR; identical on base and candidate and unrelated to this unit, but the full suite cannot be run green from a /tmp-rooted review directory.
